zh.principle: **协议**：ACME 续期信息（ACME Renewal Information）。§1 定义扩展：「This document specifies the ACME Renewal Information (ARI) extension」，服务器提供建议窗口、客户回报已替换旧证。§3 给出发现方式：「An ACME server that wishes to provide renewal information MUST include a new field, “renewalInfo”, in its directory object.」§4.1 规定查询形态——「the client sends an unauthenticated GET request to a path under the server's renewalInfo URL.」路径标识由 AKI keyIdentifier 与 DER 序列号拼成，并要求「All trailing “=” characters MUST be stripped from both parts of the unique identifier.」
zh.why: 动机是客户端排期方式太僵。§1 说「Most ACME [RFC8555] clients today choose when to attempt to renew a certificate in one of three ways」并批评前两种「The first two create significant barriers against the issuing Certification Authority (CA) changing certificate lifetimes.」以及共同的后果「All three ways may lead to load clustering for the issuing CA due to its inability to schedule renewal requests.」给出的收益是「Allowing issuing CAs to suggest a period in which clients should renew their certificates enables dynamic time-based load balancing.」摘要把目标压成一句：「This allows servers to mitigate load spikes and ensures that clients do not make false assumptions about appropriate certificate renewal periods.」
zh.used: 核心对象是 suggestedWindow，§4.2 定义为「which bound the window of time in which the CA recommends renewing the certificate.」客户行为被要求为「Clients MUST attempt renewal at a time of their choosing based on the suggested renewal window.」§4.2 给出的 RECOMMENDED 算法共六步，第一步是「Make a renewalInfo request to get a suggested renewal window.」第二步才是「Select a uniform random time within the suggested window.」轮询节奏由 Retry-After 控制，§4.3 特别澄清语义：「In this protocol, it indicates the desired (i.e., both requested minimum and maximum) amount of time to wait.」§5 在 Order 对象上加 replaces 字段——「A string uniquely identifying a previously issued certificate that this order is intended to replace.」
zh.broken: 窗口本身可能被写坏，§4.2 立规矩：「A RenewalInfo object in which the end timestamp equals or precedes the start timestamp is invalid.」客户在拿到这种响应时须当作没收到。§4.3 限定使用时机——「Clients MUST NOT check a certificate's RenewalInfo after the certificate has expired.」§6 记录两处代价：其一，改用无认证 GET 是「a departure from the requirement in RFC 8555 that clients send POST-as-GET requests to fetch resources from the server.」因此「servers should take measures to ensure that unauthenticated requests for renewal information cannot result in denial-of-service attacks.」其二，时钟不同步会带来偏差：「this protocol could exhibit undesired behavior in the presence of significant clock skew between the ACME client and server.」
zh.history: RFC 9773 署名 A.Gable（Internet Security Research Group），2025 年 6 月发布，Category: Standards Track，头部无 Obsoletes 行，是 RFC 8555 之上的扩展。§2 约定术语覆盖范围——「renewal」包含 RFC 3647 定义的 Renewal、Re-Key 与 Modification 的任意组合。§4.2 还留了运维接口：explanationURL 指向可解释窗口成因的页面，规范要求「Clients SHOULD provide this URL to their operator, if present.」

en.principle: **Protocol**: ACME Renewal Information (ACME 续期信息). §1 defines the extension: "This document specifies the ACME Renewal Information (ARI) extension", where servers publish suggested renewal windows and clients signal that a certificate was replaced. §3 gives discovery: "An ACME server that wishes to provide renewal information MUST include a new field, “renewalInfo”, in its directory object." §4.1 fixes the query shape — "the client sends an unauthenticated GET request to a path under the server's renewalInfo URL." — with the path identifier built from the AKI keyIdentifier and the DER serial, and "All trailing “=” characters MUST be stripped from both parts of the unique identifier."
en.why: The motivation is rigid client scheduling. §1 notes "Most ACME [RFC8555] clients today choose when to attempt to renew a certificate in one of three ways", criticises the first two — "The first two create significant barriers against the issuing Certification Authority (CA) changing certificate lifetimes." — and the shared consequence "All three ways may lead to load clustering for the issuing CA due to its inability to schedule renewal requests." The stated benefit is "Allowing issuing CAs to suggest a period in which clients should renew their certificates enables dynamic time-based load balancing." The abstract compresses the goal: "This allows servers to mitigate load spikes and ensures that clients do not make false assumptions about appropriate certificate renewal periods."
en.used: The core field is suggestedWindow, defined in §4.2 by "which bound the window of time in which the CA recommends renewing the certificate." Client behaviour is required: "Clients MUST attempt renewal at a time of their choosing based on the suggested renewal window." The six-step RECOMMENDED algorithm in §4.2 begins with "Make a renewalInfo request to get a suggested renewal window." and only then "Select a uniform random time within the suggested window." Polling is governed by Retry-After, with §4.3 clarifying the meaning: "In this protocol, it indicates the desired (i.e., both requested minimum and maximum) amount of time to wait." §5 adds the replaces field to the Order object: "A string uniquely identifying a previously issued certificate that this order is intended to replace."
en.broken: Windows can be malformed, and §4.2 sets the rule: "A RenewalInfo object in which the end timestamp equals or precedes the start timestamp is invalid." — a client must treat such a response as if nothing arrived. §4.3 bounds when the resource is useful: "Clients MUST NOT check a certificate's RenewalInfo after the certificate has expired." §6 records two costs: moving to unauthenticated GETs is "a departure from the requirement in RFC 8555 that clients send POST-as-GET requests to fetch resources from the server." so "servers should take measures to ensure that unauthenticated requests for renewal information cannot result in denial-of-service attacks." and clock error matters: "this protocol could exhibit undesired behavior in the presence of significant clock skew between the ACME client and server."
en.history: RFC 9773 is signed by A. Gable (Internet Security Research Group), published June 2025 with Category: Standards Track and no Obsoletes line; it extends RFC 8555. §2 fixes vocabulary — “renewal” covers any combination of Renewal, Re-Key and Modification as defined in RFC 3647. §4.2 also leaves an operational handle: explanationURL points at a page explaining the window, and the specification says "Clients SHOULD provide this URL to their operator, if present."

zh: renewalInfo：目录对象里的 ARI 基址字段。
suggestedWindow：CA 建议续期的时间区间。
Retry-After：期望的重查间隔（含上限）。
replaces：Order 上指明被替换证书。
unauthenticated GET：可缓存、无需账号签名。
en: renewalInfo: the directory field holding the ARI base URL.
suggestedWindow: the interval the CA recommends for renewal.
replaces: the Order field naming the certificate being replaced.
Unauthenticated GET: cacheable, no account signature needed.
explanationURL: a page explaining why the window looks as it does.
